summary: --- name: directory-structure description: Nuxt project folder structure, conventions, and file organization --- # Directory Structure Nuxt uses a conventions-based directory structure. Understanding it is key to effective development. > **Directory layout:** The default `srcDir` is `app/`. All Vue application code (`app.vue`, `components/`, `composables/`, `pages/`, etc.) lives inside `app/`, while `server/`, `shared/`, `public/`, `modules/`, `layers/` and `nuxt.config.ts` stay at the project root. ## Standard Project Structure ``` my-nuxt-app/
